scope: pinned dataset acquisition and image/mask integrity
ONNX export and local prediction CLI

findings.title: Frozen model is not qualified for automated industrial acceptance/rejection
findings.resolution: Keep research/review-support labeling. Real camera, material, lighting, motion, missed-defect and deadline qualification require new representative data and a predefined independent evaluation; no frozen-test retuning.

findings.title: Existing raw-data verification could bless corruption by regenerating its reference hashes
findings.evidence: Previous audit_dataset overwrote manifest and mask checksums from whatever raw bytes were present, including --verify-only.
findings.resolution: Pinned canonical manifest and mask fingerprints now gate all acquisition/audits. --verify-only is read-only. --repair stages and fully verifies the archive before promotion, preserves a recovery backup, and rolls back failed/interrupted promotion.

findings.title: Training/evaluation image loader trusted files without checking manifest digests
findings.evidence: A modified raw image could enter optimization/inference while retaining the old recorded SHA256.
findings.resolution: load_images checks each file digest and decodes the same checked bytes; empty rows and escaped paths fail explicitly.

findings.title: Inference CLI did not bind graph, threshold and calibration artifacts
findings.evidence: Old CLI read arbitrary metadata and model.onnx without verifying they belonged to the frozen model/calibration.
findings.resolution: Frozen loader checks schema, exact tensor contract, score aliases, calibration digest/rank/normal labels, threshold equality, checkpoint-derived version and ONNX digest/size. ONNX Runtime receives the same verified bytes, closing file-replacement races. A bundled checkpoint, when present, must also match its frozen SHA256; ONNX-only inference bundles need no PyTorch file.

findings.title: CLI decision and malformed-image behavior diverged from review-support UI
findings.evidence: CLI used accept below threshold and exposed tracebacks for missing/corrupt images or artifact mismatch.
findings.resolution: Decision now within_range; --bundle selects a frozen project root; invalid/missing/corrupt/oversized/unsupported/animated images and output failures return friendly exit2. Outputs cannot overwrite the input or frozen bundle artifacts/data/reports.

findings.title: Python discarded transparency while browser used a white background
findings.evidence: An RGBA PNG could produce different observation RGB values because convertRGB ignores alpha.
findings.resolution: Python now EXIF-transposes and composites alpha over opaque white before Pillow bilinear resize. Shared still-image bounds are32..4096px per side,<=16m pixels,<=12MiB. Every one of342 opaque benchmark images was compared to the old path and is exactly unchanged. All APNG/WebP animation containers, including singleton-frame containers, are rejected by the CLI before decoding.

findings.title: Resume payload semantic validation was incomplete
findings.evidence: Old resume verified candidate/manifest/budget but did not reject impossible epoch/history, nonfinite weights, poisoned AdamW moments or mismatched step/LR state.
findings.resolution: Resume validates consecutive finite history, best error, current/best parameter names/shapes/dtypes/finiteness, AdamW steps20*epoch, LR schedule, moments and RNG states before restoring process state. Original full26epoch payload passes unchanged. Legacy compact reuse is restricted to its exact original checkpoint and manifest digest.

findings.title: Checkpoint and export paths lacked explicit integrity/finiteness checks
findings.evidence: Prior load_checkpoint directly loaded state; export could overwrite the release graph before parity completed.
findings.resolution: Checkpoint loader hashes and loads the same bytes using weights_only=True, validates configuration and finite state, and wraps unsafe/corrupt payload failures as ValueError. Export requires the frozen checkpoint digest and valid calibration metadata, writes a temporary graph, and promotes after parity succeeds.

findings.title: Selection and evaluated checkpoint were not explicitly bound
findings.evidence: A stale checkpoint could be evaluated beside a different development selection report.
findings.resolution: Selection loader checks manifest digest, four planned comparisons, recorded winner rule and exclusion flags. Evaluation compares selected candidate configuration and exact tensors against the final checkpoint before calibration/test loading.

findings.title: Manifest and archive schema admitted ambiguous paths/categories
findings.evidence: Old extraction did not reject duplicate normalized targets or Windows separators; manifest did not fully bind label, defect, mask and source partition paths.
findings.resolution: Reject duplicate archive targets, unsafe member types, traversal, Windows paths, excess count/size; require canonical manifest schema/paths and matching label/category/mask relationships.

findings.title: evaluate/export --help could execute expensive or mutating work
findings.evidence: These scripts previously ignored command-line options and had no argument parser.
findings.resolution: Both now handle --help without doing evaluation/export and reject unknown options before work.

findings.title: Cross-runtime resizing and benchmark timing do not establish factory performance
findings.evidence: Pillow and browser canvas interpolation/color handling can differ for arbitrary uploads; native/WASM tests do not exercise a physical inspection line.
findings.resolution: Use identically preprocessed tracked samples for parity. Treat reported latency as environment-specific inference timing, not a line-rate or deadline guarantee. Data remain CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; original code licensing does not replace data rights.

verification.raw_verify_only: passed fresh after environment restore, all342images/57masks; metadata preserved
verification.raw_repair: passed fresh pinned-cache extraction, complete staged verification and promotion

independent_adversarial_tests.scope: Fresh post-reset independent reviewer run. Singleton-animation/checkpoint-present regressions and final whole-project suite are reported separately by the reviewer.

bounded_training_continuity.scope: Actual train_candidate loop using a tiny1x1convolution+sigmoid substitute and two deterministic64x64images. Original1280patches/epoch,batch64,AdamW/noise/flip logic;2epochs uninterrupted versus atomic epoch1 interruption+resume epoch2. Final selected weights and epoch losses exactly identical. This tests continuity software, not full-network training quality.

reproduction.default_train_entrypoint: Reuse matching completed candidate-*.pt; otherwise resume matching training-resume-*.pt; otherwise fit from scratch. Full raw dataset is required even for cached development reproduction.
reproduction.fresh_run: Use a separate clean checkout/copy, move candidate-*.pt and training-resume-*.pt out of artifacts, install the declared training environment, run download_data.py; train.py --epochs26; evaluate.py; export_model.py in order. Do not run fresh experiments over the published frozen release.
reproduction.training_split: 160 normal fit images only;52normal tune and52normal calibration held out. Training on all264normal images would consume this calibration set and requires separate independent calibration data.
reproduction.floating_point_limit: Same-runtime exact continuity can be tested; independent hardware/library versions can change floating-point results. No bitwise cross-version retraining claim.

limits: This scoped audit tests concrete failure classes; it cannot prove all possible inputs, devices or future operating conditions safe. Frozen benchmark scores were not used to retune model, score aggregation or threshold.
